verdict.rationale: The API is visibly versioned: the docs live under /api/v2/ and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published. The JS client also keeps a changelog. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or a versioning-compatibility guarantee, so only half the story is shown, and only by implication. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with notice periods, an explicit API versioning and breaking-change policy, and independent corroboration of version stability.
